conclusion_adjustments: Do not estimate population prevalence from two eligible cases.
Do not claim specificity or false-positive control from an eligible set with zero negative cases.
Treat the two mismatches as confirmed case findings, not a representative rate.
Treat CFF version missingness as a secondary descriptive result because version is optional in CFF 1.2.0.

stronger_baseline.consequence: The contribution is the explicit protocol, exclusions, benchmark records, CI integration, and audit trail—not a novel comparison algorithm.
stronger_baseline.description: A direct two-file raw-string comparator is algorithmically equivalent to exact-mode checking on eligible records.
